notice: Official-law citations and author-side rationale are provisional source leads. This ledger does not certify every A-D legal proposition or exception; no candidate is approved for Form C use. Resolve HOLD and check each option before release.
review_contract: Read the exact current legal text, its dates, jurisdiction and exceptions.
Check a single SBA or exact SATA key; validate each A-D rationale against cited law.
Review alternative defensible interpretations, public policy conflict, novelty and misleading shortcuts.
If materially uncertain, HOLD and replace within same Area; never auto-fix key based on style alone.
